components.name: left_side_panel
components.description: Full-height left structural panel, 6 x 32 x 200 mm, assembled at center (-47, 0, 100). It has a warm reddish-brown wood appearance with subtle vertical grain. Its inner face receives two separated tab slots from every horizontal member.

components.name: right_side_panel
components.description: Full-height right structural panel, 6 x 32 x 200 mm, assembled at center (47, 0, 100). It mirrors the left panel, has subtle vertical wood grain, and receives two separated tab slots from every horizontal member.

components.name: shelf_1_bottom
components.description: Lowest of five usable shelf boards, 88 x 32 x 6 mm, centered at (0, 0, 3). It spans exactly between the side-panel inner faces and carries front and rear end tabs at both left and right ends.

components.name: shelf_2
components.description: Second usable shelf board, 88 x 32 x 6 mm, centered at (0, 0, 41.8). It is horizontal and carries front and rear end tabs at both ends.

components.name: shelf_3
components.description: Third usable shelf board, 88 x 32 x 6 mm, centered at (0, 0, 80.6). It is horizontal and carries front and rear end tabs at both ends.

components.name: shelf_4
components.description: Fourth usable shelf board, 88 x 32 x 6 mm, centered at (0, 0, 119.4). It is horizontal and carries front and rear end tabs at both ends.

components.name: shelf_5
components.description: Fifth usable shelf board, 88 x 32 x 6 mm, centered at (0, 0, 158.2). It is horizontal and carries front and rear end tabs at both ends.

components.name: top_cap
components.description: Top structural cap, 88 x 32 x 6 mm, centered at (0, 0, 197). It closes the upper frame without being counted among the five usable shelves and carries front and rear end tabs at both ends.

relations: The assembled bookshelf has an exact overall envelope of 100 mm in x, 32 mm in y, and 200 mm in z.
World coordinates use +x right, +y inward/back, and +z up; the open display face is toward -y.
The left and right side panels are vertical, parallel, and mirror-symmetric about x=0. Their inner faces lie at x=-44 and x=44 respectively.
All six horizontal members span the 88 mm clear distance between the side-panel inner faces and share x=0 and y=0.

The five shelf centers occur at z=3, 41.8, 80.6, 119.4, and 158.2 mm. The top-cap center is z=197 mm. Adjacent horizontal boards therefore create five evenly spaced open compartments with 32.8 mm clear height.
There is no back panel, door, plinth, or diagonal brace; both front and rear remain visually open to preserve the streamlined minimalist character.
Every horizontal-member-to-side-panel junction uses two distinct tab-slot interfaces, one near the front and one near the rear, to resist rotation and cover the full physical attachment arrangement.
Front and rear connector centerlines should be separated along y, nominally at y=-10 mm and y=10 mm, while remaining fully inside the 32 mm panel depth.
At each left end, tabs insert from the horizontal member into the left side panel along -x. At each right end, tabs insert into the right side panel along +x.

Use one shared TabSlot parameter named shelf_side_tabslot for all interfaces: approximately 10 mm tab width along y, 3.5 mm tab thickness along z, 4 mm insertion, slot depth at least 4 mm, and the frozen single-sided fit allowance of 0.2 mm. Retain sufficient shoulder and embedded-root material in every shelf and sufficient surrounding wall material in each side panel.

All visible structural pieces use a warm reddish-brown base color. Wood texture should remain restrained and directional: predominantly vertical on side panels and lengthwise along x on shelves and the top cap.
The two side panels reach the floor at z=0, and shelf_1_bottom also has its lower face at z=0, providing a broad, level standing footprint.
critic_checklist: Verify that the final assembled bounding size is exactly 100 x 32 x 200 mm at mm_per_unit=1.0.
Verify that there are exactly five clearly identifiable usable shelves plus one separate top cap; do not count the top cap as a sixth shelf.
Verify shelf centers at z=3, 41.8, 80.6, 119.4, and 158.2 mm, with the top cap centered at z=197 mm.
Verify that the five open compartments have equal clear height of approximately 32.8 mm and are unobstructed from the front.
Verify that both side panels are 6 mm thick, extend continuously from z=0 to z=200, and have outer faces at x=-50 and x=50.
Verify that each horizontal board is level, 6 mm thick, 32 mm deep, and spans between x=-44 and x=44 before generated connector protrusions.
Verify that no back panel, front rail, door, or decorative cross-brace blocks the open minimalist compartments.
Verify a warm reddish-brown finish across all parts, with visible but subtle wood-like directional texture rather than a flat plastic appearance.
Verify that all eight semantic components are assigned to explicit print parts and that the result retains multiple separately printable bodies.
Verify that every horizontal member has four declared interfaces: left-front, left-rear, right-front, and right-rear, for a total of 24 tab-slot connections.
Verify that every connection has unique endpoint port names and that front and rear interfaces are geometrically separated rather than duplicated at one location.

Verify ordered placement starts from left_side_panel: the first left interface places each horizontal member, and the first right interface of shelf_1_bottom places right_side_panel before later right-side interfaces are checked.
Verify all left-end tab insertion directions are -x and all right-end tab insertion directions are +x.
Verify all connections use the frozen fit_offset_mm of 0.2 without alteration and use the shared shelf_side_tabslot dimensions consistently.
Verify adequate solid material surrounds all side-panel slots, especially those adjacent to z=0 and z=200, and that tabs have shoulders embedded in their shelf bodies.
Verify the assembled object stands with both side-panel bottoms and the bottom shelf lower face on the z=0 floor, without any component extending below the floor.
Verify assembly_topology reports complete declared-interface coverage and a single connected assembly graph.

Verify assembly_standing evidence covers all independent printed bodies and all declared interfaces under the frozen five-second gravity-only settings; do not claim fixation, strength, or external-load capacity beyond that evidence.
